name: Remix
source:
Remix is some sort of sonic enchantress, empowered by something called the Cosmic Beat, that all living things dance to. She may be a little spacey at times, but she spins one heck of a DJ set! I know her from Music club, where she's either composing solid songs or listening to a tune playing a galaxy away... She seems to like Cool people.

[From in-game profile]
